title: Desktop Settings
items: New desktop settings in the More menu: Windowed, Fullscreen (and Borderless on Mac), window size from 1280×720 up to 4K, monitor choice, and frame rate (match your screen or unlimited)
Tithe remembers how you left it: window mode, window size (including sizes you drag yourself), monitor and frame rate all carry over to the next launch
Quit to desktop from the More menu
F11 or Alt+Enter still toggles fullscreen at any time

title: The Desktop Launcher
items: Tithe now has its own desktop app for Mac and Windows, opening into a launcher with patch notes and one-click updates
Updates download only the files that changed, and pick up where they left off if you close the launcher mid-download
Launcher settings: auto-update, repair game files, and hide/minimize/close while you play

Includes everything on play.tithecardgame.com: The Uncounted deck, the Shambler cap (3 per side), attack-in-one-tap, faster banner summons, card previews while searching, and daily deals that refresh together
